title: Bringing Salesforce into Claude
summary: Anthropic launched a beta Salesforce plugin for Claude with 37 skills for sales workflows, integrating Salesforce and Slack connectors for accessing accounts and opportunities. Features include daily briefings, call prep, deal scoring, and pipeline dashboards, with early adoption by GitLab, Siemens, and Legora.

title: Claude for Small Business launches new workflows, integrations, and training programs
summary: Claude for Small Business expanded to 43 workflows and 27 new integrations including Shopify, Salesforce, Gusto, and tools for e-commerce, CRM, project management, and accounting. New free training workshops in 10 U.S. cities (Sept–Nov) help small business owners apply Claude to lead generation, proposal writing, marketing, and financial tasks.

title: T. Rowe Price brings more of Claude to its investment process
summary: T. Rowe Price expanded Claude deployment into core investment operations beyond back-office functions, using Cowork for research synthesis and Claude Code for building investment tools. The deployment operates under T. Rowe Price's AI leadership model and aims to boost analyst and portfolio manager capacity for research while maintaining human judgment.

title: How Healthcare Organizations Use Claude Tag
summary: Claude Tag, a beta feature in Slack, brings Claude into channels as a teammate via @Claude mentions. It reads threads, accesses connected tools, and retains channel memory, enabling healthcare organizations to automate processes like alert handling while maintaining granular access controls for PHI compliance.

title: Building an AI-native revenue organization
summary: Anthropic released an eBook for revenue leaders implementing Claude in sales organizations, covering maturity models, rollout strategies, ROI measurement, and a 3-phase implementation plan mapped by sales role. Cox Communications is cited achieving 7x ROI in the first year of AI investment.

title: Agentic coding is straining CI. Here's how we scaled test impact analysis at Anthropic
summary: Anthropic scaled test impact analysis infrastructure as CI job volume grew 25x with Claude authoring 80% of code. The redesign replaced temporary fixes with an in-memory data store and stateless, horizontally-scalable workers. Teams should anticipate 25x load increases within two quarters under agentic coding workflows.
